morning.title: Manual trading has one weak spot: you.
body: Fear closes good trades too early. Hurry opens bad ones. Tiredness misses both.
Fixed rules don't get scared, rushed or tired.
morning.caption:
Fear closes good trades too early. Hurry opens bad ones. Tiredness misses both.

That's why FTM MACHINE trades by fixed rules: the same decision at 3 a.m. as at 3 p.m.

Would you trust your own decisions at the end of a long shift?

morning.title: Copy trading: whose risk are you copying?
body: When you copy a person, you copy their bad days, their risk size and their mood.
You usually find out after it happened.
morning.caption:
Copy trading sounds easy: find someone good and copy them.

But you also copy their bad days, their risk size and their mood, and you usually find out after it happened.

Before you copy anyone, ask: who controls the risk, and can I see every single trade?

morning.title: Three questions to ask any trading system.
body: 1. Can I see every trade?
2. Does my money stay in my own account?
3. Are the losing days shown too?

morning.title: Discipline is hard. Code is consistent.
body: People change their rules after one bad trade.
FTM MACHINE follows the same rules on Monday morning and Friday night.
morning.caption:
Most people change their rules after one bad trade. Then again after the next one.

FTM MACHINE follows the same rules on Monday morning and Friday night. No revenge trades, no guessing.

That's the difference automation makes.

morning.title: Losing days are part of it.
body: Every system has them. Anyone who only shows winning days is hiding something.
We post every day's result, good or bad. Look at months, not single days.
morning.caption:
Every trading system has losing days. Anyone who only shows the winning ones is hiding something.

We post the FTM master account's result every evening, good or bad. Judge any system by months, not by one day.

Automation: you follow fixed rules you can see, every trade, every day.
